virtues.name: Wisdom
virtues.definition: Seeing things as they are, and telling what is yours to choose from what is not.
prompts: What here is in your control, and what is not?
What would you see if you set your first impression aside?
Which choice today deserves a moment of thought?

virtues.name: Courage
virtues.definition: Acting rightly in the face of fear, pain or difficulty.
prompts: Where might fear decide for you today?
What hard thing is worth doing anyway?
Where can you speak or act honestly, even if it is uncomfortable?

virtues.name: Justice
virtues.definition: Treating others fairly and acting for the common good.
prompts: Who could you treat with more fairness or patience today?
How might your choices today serve the people around you?
Whose point of view have you not yet considered?

virtues.name: Temperance
virtues.definition: Choosing measure and self-restraint in what you want, say and do.
prompts: Where would a little restraint serve you today?
What can you let pass without reacting?
